businessProducts.noLimitTitle: Charge this rate for every larger order. Only the final band can be open-ended.
businessProducts.rangeHint: Tick {noLimit} on the highest band to make it open-ended, so every larger order gets that rate. Without it, orders above that quantity are charged the full retail price instead of a bulk rate.
businessProducts.issueMinAtLeastOne: Row {line}: the minimum quantity must be at least 1.
businessProducts.issueMaxBelowMin: Row {line}: the maximum quantity is below the minimum.
businessProducts.issueTwoOpen: Rows {first} and {second} both have no maximum quantity. Only the final band can be open-ended.
businessProducts.issueOpenNotLast: Row {line} has no maximum quantity, so it covers every order of {min} or more and row {above} could never apply. An open-ended band must be the final one.
businessProducts.issueOverlap: Row {line}: this quantity range overlaps row {other}.
businessProducts.issueGap: Row {line} starts at {min} but row {previous} ends at {max}, so an order of {missing} would be charged the full retail price. Bands must run on from one another without a gap.
businessProducts.issueNoOpenTop: The highest band stops at {max}, so an order of {next} or more is charged the full retail price. Tick No limit on row {line} to give it that rate too.
businessProducts.openTierNotLast: An open-ended pricing tier must be the final tier. Set a maximum quantity on {label} before adding another tier.
